name: hotel_search_agent
description: Searches Dayuse day-use hotel offers (by destination or by hotel name) via the read-only MCP_B2C server; stateless — profile in/out through the A2A DataPart.

skills.name: hotel_search
skills.description: Given query_params (destination, dates, filters, or a hotel name) plus profile_in, returns {results, profile_delta, diagnostics} from the read-only MCP_B2C tools search_offers / find_hotel_by_name. Stateless: no session, no Redis.

bearer-interim.description: Interim static bearer over the private network (D7 exception, unsigned card); replaced by oidc-mtls at the latest before the S11 canary.
